title: 第十九章 嫁祸第二十章 王颖的震惊
lines: 一阵狂揍，张悬这才觉得心中舒服了不少。
低头一看，此刻的姚33寒脸上的面罩已经掉了，整个人也被打的满是扭曲，亲妈都认不出来了。
气消了，张悬脑子再次灵活起来：“这家伙是白玉城城主的管家，又是我徒弟的叔叔，教训一顿可以，不能杀死！”
不管怎么说这家伙都是赵雅的姚叔叔，真要杀了，刚收的这个弟子还不炸锅？
以后肯定也没和好的可能了！
而且，白玉城号称天玄王国第三大城市，能做为城主，实力必然不弱，肯定还拥有极大的势力，管家被杀，仔细追究，弄不还就能查到自己身上，麻烦不小。
刚来这个世界，还没彻底站稳脚跟，还是低调一些好。
“不能让他怀疑到我头上！”
心中一动。
既然不能杀，那就只能让其活着离开，跑过来偷袭自己，却被人揍了，肯定会怀疑！
“对了，刚好有个替死鬼，今天不找我麻烦，还想不起来……”
突然想到了一个人。
正是白天遇到沈碧柔时，一直嘲笑自己的尚斌。
反正这家伙是尚臣长老的孙子，嫁祸给他，姚寒就算知道，也应该不敢报复！
即便报复，互相撕咬，更好！
想到这，张悬低头看向已经被打面目全非的姚寒，压低了声音：“我和张悬是有矛盾，他白天气我，我今天晚上本打算过来教训他一顿的！不过，如果他真被你阉了，碧……她肯定会以为是我干的，对我产生误会！要怪，就怪你被我撞见，来的不是时候！”
姚寒这才知道为何被揍，想要反驳，嘴已经肿胀的如同香肠，连话都说不出来了。
见对方听懂了自己的意思，张悬不在废话，站起身来，一脚踹在姚寒身上，将其踢飞十几米。
“可恶！”
心中暗暗骂了一句，姚寒也知道今天再打下去，肯定倒霉的还是自己，一咬牙转身就走。
同时记住了两个特征，第一，打他的这个人白天刚和张悬打过交道，被他气了！第二，他和张悬之间应该是情敌，追求的那个女子，名字中带“碧”。
只要知道这两点，打听出今天对他出手的家伙到底是谁，还是很容易的。
见姚寒离开，张悬这才松了口气，收拾了一下，重新回到宿舍。
说起来真够惊险的，要不是今晚上修炼，到现在还没睡，真不知道会发生什么。
不过，至少危险暂时解除了。
“在这个世界生存……实力才是最重要的！”
坐在宿舍的床上，张悬心中暗自嘀咕。
如果今晚修为没进步，就算知道姚寒的缺点，肯定也打不过，吃亏的必然是自己。
所以，当务之急没有别的，那就是快速提升实力，力量越强越好！
心中带着感慨，逐渐进入梦乡。
第二天，天一亮就醒了过来，虽然只睡了不到两个时辰，又折腾了这么长时间，却依旧感到精力充沛，没有丝毫困倦。
“该去上课了！”
嘀咕一声，穿上衣服，张悬大步向自己的课堂走去。
时间不长，来到课堂，刚推门走进去，看到一个胖子兴奋地迎了上来。
“张老师，你来了，你看我已经把房间打扫完了！”
正是最后收的那个胖子袁涛。
这家伙被自己威胁，没想到今天果然第一个来了，而且还把房间打扫的干干净净。
content_en:
After beating him wildly for a while, Zhang Xuan felt a lot more comfortable.
Looking down, he saw that the mask on Yao Sanhan's face had fallen off, and his whole body was so distorted that even his own mother could not recognize him.
"Uh..."
After his anger subsided, Zhang Xuan's mind became clear again: "This guy is the butler of the Lord of White Jade City and the uncle of my apprentice. You can teach him a lesson, but you can't kill him!"
No matter what, this guy is Zhao Ya's Uncle Yao. If he really wants to kill him, why don't he just accept this disciple?
There will definitely be no possibility of reconciliation in the future!
Moreover, White Jade City is known as the third largest city in the Tianxuan Kingdom. As a city lord, he must be not weak and must have great power. The housekeeper was killed. If he investigates carefully, he will be traced if he doesn't pay back. It will be a big trouble.
I have just come to this world and haven’t completely established myself yet, so it’s better to keep a low profile.
"We can't let him doubt me!"
Something moved in my heart.
Since he can't be killed, he can only let him leave alive. If he comes to sneak attack on him, but is beaten, he will definitely be suspicious!
"By the way, there happens to be a scapegoat. If he doesn't cause trouble for me today, I still can't remember..."
Suddenly I thought of someone.
It was Shang Bin who had been laughing at him when he met Shen Birou during the day.
Anyway, this guy is the grandson of Elder Shangchen. If he is blamed, Yao Han should not dare to take revenge even if he knows!
Even if we take revenge and bite each other, it’s better!
Thinking of this, Zhang Xuan looked down at Yao Han, who had been beaten beyond recognition, and lowered his voice: "Zhang Xuan and I have a conflict. He cheated on me during the day, and I planned to come over and teach him a lesson tonight! However, if he is really castrated by you, Bi...she will definitely think that it was me who did it and misunderstand me! If you want to blame, blame me for catching you at the wrong time!"
"..."
Only then did Yao Han realize why he was beaten. He wanted to retort, but his mouth was swollen like a sausage and he couldn't even speak.
"Get out!"
Seeing that the other party understood what he meant, Zhang Xuan stopped talking nonsense, stood up, and kicked Yao Han, sending him flying more than ten meters.
"Damn it!"
Yao Han cursed secretly in his heart, knowing that if he continued to fight today, he would definitely be the unlucky one, so he gritted his teeth and turned around to leave.
I remembered two characteristics at the same time. First, the person who hit him had just dealt with Zhang Xuan during the day and was angry with him! Secondly, he and Zhang Xuan should be love rivals, and the woman he is pursuing has "Bi" in her name.
As long as you know these two points, it is easy to find out who the guy who attacked him today is.
Seeing Yao Han leave, Zhang Xuan breathed a sigh of relief, packed up and returned to the dormitory.
It's really thrilling to say that if I hadn't practiced tonight and still haven't slept yet, I really don't know what would have happened.
However, at least the danger is temporarily lifted.
"To survive in this world...strength is the most important thing!"
Sitting on the bed in the dormitory, Zhang Xuan muttered to himself.
If his cultivation does not improve tonight, even if he knows Yao Han's shortcomings, he will definitely not be able to defeat him, and he will definitely suffer the loss.
Therefore, the top priority is to quickly improve your strength. The stronger the better!
With emotion in my heart, I gradually fell asleep.
The next day, I woke up at dawn. Although I only slept for less than two hours and worked hard for such a long time, I still felt energetic and not sleepy at all.
"It's time to go to class!"
With a murmur, Zhang Xuan put on his clothes and strode towards his classroom.
It didn't take long and I arrived at the classroom. As soon as I opened the door and walked in, I saw a fat man coming up to me excitedly.
"Teacher Zhang, you are here. Look, I have finished cleaning the room!"
It was the fat man Yuan Tao who was taken in last.
This guy was threatened by me, but he didn't expect to be the first one to come today, and he also cleaned the room.
title_en: Chapter 19: Framing Chapter 20: Wang Ying’s Shock
